_help: Act 2, the museum, first visit (one action): the chief archivist refuses, names Eleanor and Pembroke (knows_eleanor, knows_pembroke), and you may approach ONE of them in the same visit (the el_ / pe_ nodes are act2_eleanor / act2_pembroke). Later visits use the find_ actions. Until you learn the names (museum_staff_known) you can come back and ask again. Threatening him: archivist_hostile + event fight_museum_guards (end_fight); Eleanor saw it (knows_eleanor). The 20-pound donation (archivist_bribed) opens the locked cabinet in act2_archive. Generated by tools/dialogue/make_act2.py.

again.speaker: archivist
again.line: You again. My answer has not improved overnight.

first.speaker: archivist
first.line: Another treasure hunter. This is a museum, sir, not a hiring hall. State your business, and be brief.

choices.label: Ask for an Egyptologist
choices.line: I'm putting together a private expedition. I need an Egyptologist, and they tell me you have the best in Cairo.

choices.label: Mention Akmentar
choices.line: We're going after the tombs of Akmentar.

choices.label: Leave
choices.line: I'll see myself out.

myth.speaker: archivist
myth.line: Akmentar is a story camel drivers tell tourists for a few piastres. There is no tomb, and there never was.

ask.speaker: archivist
ask.line: Absolutely not. No scholar of this museum will be seen chasing fairy tales with a hired gun.

choices.label: Ask about his staff
choices.line: Surely not everyone here agrees with you.

choices.label: Offer a donation
choices.line: The museum could use a generous donation. Shall we say twenty pounds?

choices.label: Threaten him
choices.line: Find me someone, Professor, or I'll make this your problem. Personally.

choices.label: Leave
choices.line: Suit yourself.

bribe.speaker: archivist
bribe.line: Twenty pounds buys the museum a display case. It does not buy you my staff. It may buy you a look at our basement, if you insist on wasting your time.

staff.speaker: archivist
staff.line: Two of my people might be foolish enough. Miss Whitmore believes every legend she translates. Dr. Pembroke believes nothing he cannot catalogue, and badly needs a success.

pick.speaker: archivist
pick.line: Speak to one of them, if you must. The other I need at work today.

choices.label: Approach Miss Whitmore
choices.line: Miss Whitmore? A word, if you have one.

choices.label: Approach Dr. Pembroke
choices.line: Dr. Pembroke? A moment of your time.

choices.label: Leave
choices.line: Thank you, Professor. That's all.

threat.speaker: archivist
threat.line: You dare threaten me in my own museum? Guards! Remove this man!

el_already.speaker: eleanor
el_already.line: I've packed my notebooks twice already. Tell me we leave soon.

el_first.speaker: eleanor
el_first.line: You're the one asking about Akmentar. I heard every word through the Professor's door.

el_menu.speaker: eleanor
el_menu.line: Well? He won't help you. I might.

choices.label: Invite her along
choices.line: Then you heard I need an Egyptologist. Come with us.

choices.label: Ask what she knows
choices.line: What do you know about Akmentar that he doesn't?

choices.label: Doubt her
choices.line: You've never been further than the reading room, have you?

choices.label: Leave
choices.line: Sorry to have bothered you, miss.

el_knows.speaker: eleanor
el_knows.line: Three papyri in our own basement name a king who appears on no list. Someone went to a great deal of trouble to forget him. I'd like to know why.

el_doubt.speaker: eleanor
el_doubt.line: I've read every account of every expedition that never came back. Which is more than your hired guns have done.

el_terms.speaker: eleanor
el_terms.line: Two conditions. Whatever we find, I publish, under my own name. And I am not your secretary.

choices.label: Promise
choices.line: Your name, your work. You have my word.

choices.label: Make no promises
choices.line: Let's find it first, then argue about the credit.

el_fee.speaker: eleanor
el_fee.line: The museum pays me ten pounds a month to fetch other people's books. I won't ask you for more than that.

choices.label: Pay her properly
choices.line: Thirty pounds. You'll be doing a scholar's work, not a clerk's.

choices.label: Pay what she asks
choices.line: Ten pounds it is.

choices.label: Pay nothing yet
choices.line: You'll get your share when we find it.

el_joined.speaker: eleanor
el_joined.line: Then I'm coming. I'll fetch my things before the Professor finds out.

el_joined_cool.speaker: eleanor
el_joined_cool.line: Fine. I'm coming anyway. But I'm keeping my own notes.

pe_already.speaker: pembroke
pe_already.line: My equipment is crated and labelled. Every crate. I trust yours is too.

pe_first.speaker: pembroke
pe_first.line: Dr. Arthur Pembroke. I gather you want a scholar to lend your treasure hunt some respectability.

choices.label: Offer him the job
choices.line: I want a real archaeologist. Someone who does it properly.

choices.label: Ask about his last dig
choices.line: They say your last expedition went badly.

choices.label: Leave
choices.line: Forget I asked.

pe_failure.speaker: pembroke
pe_failure.line: Wadi Natrun, 1919. Bad funding, worse records. Half the finds vanished before they were catalogued, and my name went with them. I will not make that mistake twice.

pe_terms.speaker: pembroke
pe_terms.line: Seventy pounds, in advance. Every find recorded and catalogued before anyone touches it, and nothing leaves the site unregistered.

choices.label: Agree to everything
choices.line: Seventy pounds, and every find on paper. Done.

choices.label: Show him the archive papers
choices.line: I've been through the museum's own Akmentar boxes. This isn't a fairy tale, Doctor.

choices.label: Haggle
choices.line: Seventy is steep for a man who needs this more than I do.

choices.label: Admit you can't afford him
choices.line: I can't pay that.

pe_homework.speaker: pembroke
pe_homework.line: You've actually read them. Well. That changes the odds a little. Fifty pounds, and the records are mine to keep.

pe_haggle.speaker: pembroke
pe_haggle.line: I am not a porter to be haggled with. Seventy, or find yourself a cheaper conscience.

pe_broke.speaker: pembroke
pe_broke.line: Then you can't afford me. If you want a scholar who works for legends, try Dr. Hassan al-Masri in the old quarter. The museum dismissed him for less than this.

pe_joined.speaker: pembroke
pe_joined.line: Very well. I shall want a proper camera, and someone who can hold it still.
